summary: Robert F. Kennedy Jr., raised amid the pressure and tragedies of the Kennedy dynasty, went from heroin addiction and environmental law to leading an anti-vaccine group whose 2019 campaign in Samoa preceded a deadly measles epidemic.

evidence.note: Joseph P. Kennedy born 1888; long segment on his rise sets covered_span start
RFK Jr. born January 1954; childhood fills most of parts 1 and 2
after the 1968 assassination his mother beats him and repeatedly expels him from home
teenage drug use escalates to heroin; arrested for marijuana at sixteen
1974 Apurimac river expedition in Peru staged to build a heroic image
1983 overdose on a plane diverted to Rapid City, heroin arrest and probation
after Skakel's 2002 conviction he pushes an alternative-suspects theory of the Moxley murder
babysitter's account of groping and harassment in his home, 1998-99
divorce fight with Mary Richardson ends with her 2012 suicide
chairs Children's Health Defense, founded 2007 as World Mercury Project
his group's campaign in Samoa halts MMR use; 2019 outbreak kills 83, mostly young children
2023-24 presidential campaign and recorded call with Trump about a job

notes: Host frames the Kennedy dynasty itself as the main bastard; no theme fits dynasties, so electoral-politics stands in. Patrick and P.J. Kennedy (1849-1880s) get only a few minutes, so covered_span starts at Joseph P. Kennedy's 1888 birth. main_span starts at birth because childhood is half the story. Lem Billings has a real segment but is a keyword to keep subjects at five. Kenya and Egypt safaris are brief and left out of setting.
